sn45.152:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave rukkho pācīnaninno pācī napoṇo pācīnapabbhāro || so mūlechinno katamena papātena papateyyāti || || Yena bhante ninno yena poṇo yena pabbhāro ti || || Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro || || Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu a- a- maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti viveka[pe] la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu a- a- maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro ti || ||
